gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Parsing with stopAtNonOption=true tolerates an unknown short option ("-D") and still returns a CommandLine.
ADDED i3: Parsing an argument that exactly matches a declared long option ("-bdKQ") succeeds and returns a CommandLine.
ADDED i4: Flattening a token containing a known option with an argument-bearing value ("-Z&=") yields two tokens; flattening that result again is stable.
ADDED i5: A long token ("---") that ambiguously matches two declared long options ("---" and "--") causes an AmbiguousOptionException from PosixParser.
ADDED i7: When a long option is declared with a null short option, parsing the matching token ("---") triggers a NullPointerException inside PosixParser.
ADDED i9: A long-option token with no matching declared option ("--=") is rejected with an "Unrecognized option" exception from Parser.
ADDED i11: Flattening a non-option token with stopAtNonOption=true inserts the "--" marker (giving 7 tokens); a second flatten with stopAtNonOption=false keeps only the ma
ADDED i12: A lone hyphen ("-") is treated as a regular token, so parsing succeeds and returns a CommandLine.
ADDED i13: Bursting a clustered token ("-ZA") where only "Z" is a known option splits it into four flattened tokens.
ADDED i14: With no options declared and stopAtNonOption=false, a token starting with a hyphen but matching nothing ("-Z&=") collapses to a single flattened token.
ADDED i15: Bursting an empty token is a no-op and does not throw.
ADDED i16: After a parse initializes the parser's internal options state, bursting a token ("wZ") whose characters are not declared options completes without throwing.
